context_analysis.description: This saved component covers one invocation of replica 1's handlePrepareReply for instance 0, after recovery has created nil-client bookkeeping and selected ballot 1. The entry state is a conditional cut, not an established reachable state. It retains the original PUT command snapshot separately from mutable recovery commands. Replica identity, instance identity, attempt ballot, promise ballot, value ballot and handler phase remain separate. Completing the model requires composing the original supported decision, timer enqueue, recovery dispatch, transport and protective commit paths in the same history.
excluded: The conditional entry state does not establish the earlier decision, distinct installation witnesses, timer-driven recovery or reply production.
The component ends before bcastAccept. It does not assume broadcast completion or message delivery.
Protective full Commit and malformed CommitShort traffic are not composed into this component; their omission is a core behavior gap, not an environment guarantee.

Later authentic PrepareReply invocations are outside this invocation prefix. They must remain enabled in the composed model because the implementation neither resets the counters here nor guards this handler against COMMITTED status.
Application execution, concurrent reads of partially updated instance fields and local mutex interactions remain pending.
Durable restart, membership changes and client-proposal replacement remain outside the selected obligation scope.

reachability.description: Component-only reachability from an assumed handler-entry cut to its assignment boundary. This cannot establish the required same-history original-decision-to-recovery interaction. Execution is blocked until the missing behavior composition is supplied.

draft.description: The discriminating implementation experiment would first obtain actual PUT installations at replicas 1 and 2 and a matching handleAcceptReply COMMITTED transition at replica 0, retain a deep command snapshot, observe the execution loop enqueue recovery at replica 1, and observe the subsequent threshold assignment for the same instance. Its oracle compares complete assigned command contents with that independently retained decision snapshot. Transport delay must preserve stream order and successful send/mutex behavior; conflicting commitment and application effects need separate witnesses. A direct handler call from constructed state tests only the conditional local overwrite. The saved TLA+ component records that local control flow without claiming the required prehistory is reachable. It is not executable as the selected audit question until the explicitly pending core behavior is composed.
draft.behavior:
---- MODULE Behavior ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

CONSTANT ReplyBallots

VARIABLES pc, instCmd, instBal, instVBal, instStatus,
          selectedCmd, selectedVBal, lastTried, prepareOKs,
          nacks, maxRecv, defaults, smallestDefault, replyBal,
          assignmentEvent, originalCmd, priorSupported

vars == <<pc, instCmd, instBal, instVBal, instStatus,
          selectedCmd, selectedVBal, lastTried, prepareOKs,
          nacks, maxRecv, defaults, smallestDefault, replyBal,
          assignmentEvent, originalCmd, priorSupported>>

PutCommand == "[{op:PUT,key:0,value:[1]}]"
NoopCommand == "[{op:NONE,key:0,value:[]}]"

Init ==
    /\ pc = "entry"
    /\ instCmd = PutCommand
    /\ instBal = 0
    /\ instVBal = 0
    /\ instStatus = "ACCEPTED"
    /\ selectedCmd = "nil"
    /\ selectedVBal = -1
    /\ lastTried = 1
    /\ prepareOKs = 0
    /\ nacks = 0
    /\ maxRecv = 0
    /\ defaults = [r \in 0..2 |-> 0]
    /\ smallestDefault = -1
    /\ replyBal \in ReplyBallots
    /\ assignmentEvent = FALSE
    /\ originalCmd = PutCommand
    /\ priorSupported = TRUE

ObserveBallot ==
    /\ pc = "entry"
    /\ maxRecv' = IF replyBal > maxRecv THEN replyBal ELSE maxRecv
    /\ pc' = "compare"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<instCmd, instBal, instVBal, instStatus,
                   selectedCmd, selectedVBal, lastTried, prepareOKs,
                   nacks, defaults, smallestDefault, replyBal,
                   assignmentEvent, originalCmd, priorSupported>>

RejectStale ==
    /\ pc = "compare"
    /\ replyBal < lastTried
    /\ pc' = "returned"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<instCmd, instBal, instVBal, instStatus,
                   selectedCmd, selectedVBal, lastTried, prepareOKs,
                   nacks, maxRecv, defaults, smallestDefault, replyBal,
                   assignmentEvent, originalCmd, priorSupported>>

CountNack ==
    /\ pc = "compare"
    /\ replyBal > lastTried
    /\ nacks' = nacks + 1
    /\ pc' = "nonleaderNack"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<instCmd, instBal, instVBal, instStatus,
                   selectedCmd, selectedVBal, lastTried, prepareOKs,
                   maxRecv, defaults, smallestDefault, replyBal,
                   assignmentEvent, originalCmd, priorSupported>>

ReturnNonleaderNack ==
    /\ pc = "nonleaderNack"
    /\ pc' = "returned"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<instCmd, instBal, instVBal, instStatus,
                   selectedCmd, selectedVBal, lastTried, prepareOKs,
                   nacks, maxRecv, defaults, smallestDefault, replyBal,
                   assignmentEvent, originalCmd, priorSupported>>

SelectReplyValue ==
    /\ pc = "compare"
    /\ replyBal = lastTried
    /\ selectedVBal' = IF 0 > selectedVBal THEN 0 ELSE selectedVBal
    /\ selectedCmd' = IF 0 > selectedVBal THEN PutCommand ELSE selectedCmd
    /\ pc' = "count"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<instCmd, instBal, instVBal, instStatus,
                   lastTried, prepareOKs, nacks, maxRecv,
                   defaults, smallestDefault, replyBal,
                   assignmentEvent, originalCmd, priorSupported>>

CountMatchingReply ==
    /\ pc = "count"
    /\ prepareOKs' = prepareOKs + 1
    /\ pc' = "default"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<instCmd, instBal, instVBal, instStatus,
                   selectedCmd, selectedVBal, lastTried, nacks,
                   maxRecv, defaults, smallestDefault, replyBal,
                   assignmentEvent, originalCmd, priorSupported>>

UpdateDefault ==
    /\ pc = "default"
    /\ defaults' = IF defaults[2] < 1
                    THEN [defaults EXCEPT ![2] = 1]
                    ELSE defaults
    /\ pc' = "threshold"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<instCmd, instBal, instVBal, instStatus,
                   selectedCmd, selectedVBal, lastTried, prepareOKs,
                   nacks, maxRecv, smallestDefault, replyBal,
                   assignmentEvent, originalCmd, priorSupported>>

ChooseCommands ==
    /\ pc = "threshold"
    /\ selectedCmd' = IF prepareOKs + 1 >= 2 THEN NoopCommand ELSE selectedCmd
    /\ pc' = IF prepareOKs + 1 >= 2 THEN "assignCommands" ELSE "returned"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<instCmd, instBal, instVBal, instStatus,
                   selectedVBal, lastTried, prepareOKs, nacks,
                   maxRecv, defaults, smallestDefault, replyBal,
                   assignmentEvent, originalCmd, priorSupported>>

AssignCommands ==
    /\ pc = "assignCommands"
    /\ instCmd' = selectedCmd
    /\ pc' = "assignBallot"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<instBal, instVBal, instStatus,
                   selectedCmd, selectedVBal, lastTried, prepareOKs,
                   nacks, maxRecv, defaults, smallestDefault, replyBal,
                   assignmentEvent, originalCmd, priorSupported>>

AssignBallot ==
    /\ pc = "assignBallot"
    /\ instBal' = lastTried
    /\ pc' = "assignStatus"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<instCmd, instVBal, instStatus,
                   selectedCmd, selectedVBal, lastTried, prepareOKs,
                   nacks, maxRecv, defaults, smallestDefault, replyBal,
                   assignmentEvent, originalCmd, priorSupported>>

AssignStatus ==
    /\ pc = "assignStatus"
    /\ instStatus' = "ACCEPTED"
    /\ assignmentEvent' = TRUE
    /\ pc' = "updateSmallest"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<instCmd, instBal, instVBal,
                   selectedCmd, selectedVBal, lastTried, prepareOKs,
                   nacks, maxRecv, defaults, smallestDefault, replyBal,
                   originalCmd, priorSupported>>

KnownDefaults == {defaults[r] : r \in 0..2 /\ defaults[r] # -1}

UpdateSmallestDefault ==
    /\ pc = "updateSmallest"
    /\ LET m == CHOOSE v \in KnownDefaults : \A w \in KnownDefaults : v <= w
       IN smallestDefault' = IF m > smallestDefault THEN m ELSE smallestDefault
    /\ pc' = "persistenceDisabled"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<instCmd, instBal, instVBal, instStatus,
                   selectedCmd, selectedVBal, lastTried, prepareOKs,
                   nacks, maxRecv, defaults, replyBal,
                   assignmentEvent, originalCmd, priorSupported>>

ReachBroadcastBoundary ==
    /\ pc = "persistenceDisabled"
    /\ pc' = "broadcastBoundary"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<instCmd, instBal, instVBal, instStatus,
                   selectedCmd, selectedVBal, lastTried, prepareOKs,
                   nacks, maxRecv, defaults, smallestDefault, replyBal,
                   assignmentEvent, originalCmd, priorSupported>>

Next == ObserveBallot \/ RejectStale \/ CountNack \/ ReturnNonleaderNack
        \/ SelectReplyValue \/ CountMatchingReply \/ UpdateDefault
        \/ ChooseCommands \/ AssignCommands \/ AssignBallot \/ AssignStatus
        \/ UpdateSmallestDefault \/ ReachBroadcastBoundary
        \/ (pc \in {"returned", "broadcastBoundary"} /\ UNCHANGED vars)

ConditionalHandlerEntry == pc = "entry"
AssignmentBoundary == assignmentEvent
ConditionalAssignmentReached == assignmentEvent /\ priorSupported
ConditionalAssignmentIdentity ==
    [replica |-> 1, instance |-> 0, attempt |-> lastTried]

Obs == [phase |-> pc,
        replica |-> 1,
        instance |-> 0,
        attempt |-> lastTried,
        commands |-> instCmd,
        promise |-> instBal,
        valueBallot |-> instVBal,
        status |-> instStatus,
        prepareCount |-> prepareOKs,
        assignmentApplicable |-> (assignmentEvent /\ priorSupported),
        originalCommands |-> originalCmd]
====
draft.initial_state: Conditional handler-entry cut: replica 1 retains PUT at bal=0 and vbal=0; recovery bookkeeping has lastTriedBallot=1, nil client proposals, zero counters and selected value ballot -1. A replica-2 reply reports ballot 1, value ballot 0, default ballot 1 and PUT. The earlier supported PUT decision is an explicit assumed cut premise whose production has not been modeled. No actual observation is asserted.

constraints.constraint: Matching replies first select returned value information, increment prepareOKs and update default-ballot information. At the threshold, nil client proposals cause replacement with NOOP. The assignment writes commands, bal and status, leaving vbal unchanged.
constraints.justification: These effects are directly visible in handlePrepareReply. The component separates the instance writes and does not add a committed-status guard.

constraints.constraint: Fresh recovery bookkeeping has nil client proposals, zero reply counters and selected value ballot -1. A nonleader with replica ID 1 sets lastTriedBallot to 1.
constraints.justification: recover initializes the bookkeeping and calls makeBallot. This explains the conditional cut values; it does not establish actual recovery dispatch.

constraints.constraint: N=3, F=1, Durable=false, recovering replica 1 is not leader, and client proposals are nil.
constraints.justification: These are selected scenario bounds. ReadQuorumSize is two and persistence helpers return without storage effects. They are not observed deployment facts.

constraints.constraint: The initial cut assumes an earlier supported PUT decision and an authentic matching reply from replica 2; their producers are not represented in this component.
constraints.justification: This explicit unresolved cut permits saving the source-grounded handler component. It cannot serve as the antecedent reachability proof for the selected obligation and blocks execution as the original audit question.

constraints.constraint: The two command strings represent complete singleton command contents, including operation, key and value bytes.
constraints.justification: For the bounded PUT and NOOP values, exact string equality represents command-content equality without using pointer identity or conflating NONE with an empty command sequence.

Establishing applicability requires correlated installation and commitment witnesses; the partial model's assumed cut and a fabricated boolean are insufficient.
